instruction: Add a plain text signature to Thunderbird: "Jennifer White" on line 1, "CEO" on line 2, "InnovateTech" on line 3.

metadata.explanation: Executive signature format with three lines. Similar difficulty and interaction steps as original.
metadata.verification: Reuses existing check_thunderbird_prefs metric. Signature text verified to match regex escape requirements for special characters (dots, plus signs).

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly fetches Thunderbird prefs.js file from the correct path
Metric check_thunderbird_prefs correctly parses user_pref entries and matches against expected values using regex
Expected value correctly uses escaped newlines (\n) to verify the three-line signature format
Postconfig appropriately closes Thunderbird to ensure prefs.js is flushed to disk before reading
Minor semantic concern: instruction specifies 'plain text signature' but evaluator checks 'htmlSigText' field - though this may be how Thunderbird stores plain text signatures in practice
Evaluator does not verify the signature format setting (htmlSigFormat preference) to confirm it's truly plain text vs HTML
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider adding a check for mail.identity.id1.htmlSigFormat to verify it's set to false (plain text) in addition to checking the signature content
Alternatively, verify with actual Thunderbird behavior that plain text signatures are indeed stored in htmlSigText field

rule_validation_issues.msg: metric check_thunderbird_prefs first parameter type (str) may not match getter get_vm_file return type (Union)
